info.name: Operator Lifecycle Manager Catalog Source API

description.content:
The Operator Lifecycle Manager (OLM) extends Kubernetes with a declarative API for installing, upgrading, and managing the lifecycle of Operators and their dependencies in a cluster. OLM provides resources including CatalogSource for operator registries, OperatorGroup for namespace scoping, Subscription for tracking desired operator versions and channels, InstallPlan for reviewing pending installations, and ClusterServiceVersion as the primary operator manifest defining runtime components and RBAC rules.
